verdict.rationale: v0 docs and community evidence show single-prompt generation of both frontend UI and connected backend logic (databases, auth, Supabase/Neon/Upstash integrations) plus full-stack scaffolding and deployment, corroborated by a hands-on HN report of building a full app with auth/roles/export from prompt to deployed MVP. missing for 10: no controlled benchmark of backend logic correctness/robustness, and no independent review specifically validating backend code quality (community feedback focuses mostly on UI generation and cost).
